label: AbiA system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an AbiA-family locus whose copy number or expression modulates Lactococcus lactis resistance to multiple phages and that DefenseFinder represents with AbiA_large or AbiA_small model subrules.
observations: AbiA branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiA, hsp, AbiA_large, or AbiA_small genes, AbiA proteins, AbiA leucine-repeat variants, individual DefenseFinder HMM profiles, pTR2030-derived plasmid constructs, phage escape mutants, source database rows naming one AbiA model, and other abortive-infection systems.
